name: Budhaditya Yoga
formed_by: Conjunction of Sun and Mercury in the same house.
effects: Native is intelligent, educated, wealthy, and holds a respectable position in society.
exceptions: If this yoga occurs in the 8th house or if Mercury is combust (too close to Sun), the positive effects are diminished.

name: Gajakesari Yoga
effects: Native is highly intelligent, virtuous, famous, and has a strong moral compass. Brings immense wealth and spiritual wisdom.
exceptions: If Jupiter is debilitated (Capricorn) or aspected by Rahu/Ketu, effects are reduced.
